notes.title: Update Notes for Sep 4, 2025
notes.notes:
[list]
	[*]Fixed a crash that could happen often while playing adventure mode
	[*]Added "Texture Quality" graphics option. Low RAM devices will automatically default to low or medium texture quality.
	[*]Fixed some issues and crashes in the tortoise equipment screen
	[*]Fixed some graphical issues with shadow map settings low and medium
	[*]Other crash fixes
	[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - May 8, 2024, v10012
notes.notes:
[b]May 8, 2024, v10012[/b]
	[list]
	[*]Fixed an issue with Quick Spending on cheapest upgrades only buying war supplies for the player’s war tortoise
	[*]Fixed a bug preventing adventure melee weapons not being able to hit flying units while jumping
	[*]When auto moving to a location, locations that have been captured but are not on max level can now be chosen
	[*](PC) Greatly reduced the cost of fishing and adventure Relics
	[*]When dying and auto continue is set, the game will no longer auto continue if the player manually presses Ascend
	[*]When picking up refugees with auto battle activated, return home will automatically be selected after a time. Capped the number of refugee mice that can show at once.
	[*]Fixed the Hero Power evolution displayed power
	[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - Apr 19, 2024, v10009
notes.notes:
[h1]Apr 19, 2024, v10009[/h1]
	[list]
	[*]Fixed a bug regarding War Supply levels when quick spending
	[*]Added an option to control the ‘quick spend on war supplies?’ prompt
	[*]Players can change to the ‘cheapest’ Quick Spend method from the options menu
	[*]Bug fix: Melee allies can now target Ratling Builder turrets
	[*]Fixed a bug where Ratling Builder turrets could disappear during adventure mode
	[*]Optimizations
	[*]Refactored threading code to remove an external dependency (may fix boot up crash for some people)
	[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - Apr 8, 2024 - v10006
notes.notes:
- Added a bandaid fix where if the app crashes due to Foursaken server calls being flagged as malware, subsequent boot ups will skip all Foursaken server calls
- Fixed restore codes

notes.title: Update Notes - Apr 5, 2024 - v10005
notes.notes: Added more logs to debug a bootup crash that some users are experiencing

notes.title: Update Notes - Apr 4, 2024 - v10004
notes.notes: Fixed a bootup crash for some users (hopefully)

notes.title: Update Notes - Apr 3, 2024
notes.notes: Added debug logs to bootup process to help solve a crash.

notes.title: Update Notes - Apr 2, 2024 - v10003
notes.notes:
See the full changelog here:
[url=https://www.foursakenmedia.com/changelog.php?game=wt_pc]https://www.foursakenmedia.com/changelog.php?game=wt_pc[/url]

[list]
[*]Made hooking fish easier
[*]Improved bullet trajectory in adventure mode when shooting at units (especially flying units)
[*]After finishing daily missions, they will instantly refresh
[*]Global events will no longer end after a time, but they will be able to be manually skipped
[*]Fixed a bug with the login event, and removed it from future event rotations
[*]Adjusted the required conquest points for tiers in World 2 and beyond
[*]Bug fix: Mouse Ranger’s Medic evolution was showing the wrong number for the flat amount it heals
[*]Bug fix with tutorial
[*]Added boot up logs to help with debugging
[/list]
